title: The city beneath the aircraft
subtitle: An elevated virtual view of the observed Kowloon surface
idea: Reveal actual observed urban surface structure without completing the missing city.
limit: A small observed patch, not all Kowloon. Surfaces include roofs, ground, vegetation and possible mismatches; holes mean missing observations.
caption: Two overlapping photographs recover a broken relief of the city. The gaps are retained: the archive does not support complete walls, roofs or historical building solids here.
